stages.hlsBrowserDocumentDelivery: Exact probe bundle locally fulfilled at the owned app origin; HLS requests and CORS remain unmodified. No family-UI/login claim.
stages.latencyMethod: CRC-gecontroleerde UTC-tijdcode in werkelijk gedecodeerde videoframes, één sample/seconde/browser; geen netwerk-RTT als beeldvertraging.

browserResolution.scope: All independently observed full-occupancy samples, separately for each real browser decoder.

turnBurden.scope: Alleen eigen eth0 TURN-listeners UDP3480/TCP5349; hostbreed, niet per room.

decoderScreenshot.source: Actual first receiving WebRTC browser page after the measured hold; not the publisher canvas.

hlsDecoderScreenshot.source: Actual receiving HLS browser page after the measured hold; not the publisher canvas.

limitations: Fysieke Cast/AirPlay-metingen en echte besloten regie/beller-audio moeten afzonderlijk worden vastgelegd; HLS-HTTP-ontvangst en Chromium-decode bewijzen geen tv-weergave.

retry.scope: Only the original150 WebRTC+50 HLS phase for at least600seconds; the previous six-phase report is never rewritten.
